label: TCF3::HLF

sections.text: TCF3 encodes E2A transcription factors required for lymphoid development.
HLF encodes a PAR-bZIP transcription factor involved in circadian and hematopoietic regulation.

The t(17;19) fusion joins TCF3 transcriptional activation to the HLF DNA-binding region and produces a distinct antiapoptotic leukemia program. The leukemia can present with hypercalcemia and has marked chemotherapy resistance.
TCF3::HLF is an adverse prognostic subtype with historically very poor survival.

BCL2 inhibition has demonstrated preclinical sensitivity; blinatumomab-based treatment followed by transplantation has produced durable survivors in small clinical cohorts. These are investigational or disease-directed approaches rather than an HLF-specific FDA indication.
